description.narrative: The Learning and Education Advancement Project, is rehabilitating the Junior Secondary School Kuchingoro library and equipping it with age-appropriate textbooks for students and teachers alike. The project also seek to promote menstrual and oral hygiene among girls pupils. In addition the project would pay the PTA fees of 170 students from vulnerable households to encourage increase student enrolment. Finally the project will promote the planting of 300 trees within the school and along the Lugbe District/Airport Road Axis of the Federal Capital Territory to counteract the effect of climate change.The Learning and Education Advancement Project, is rehabilitating the Junior Secondary School Kuchingoro library and equipping it with age-appropriate textbooks for students and teachers alike.
